name: Great Notley Country Park Play Trail
text: The longest play trail in Essex, about 1.2km, in Essex County Council's Great Notley Country Park, with giant seesaws, swings, rope climbers, slides, forts and a big sand play area. Car park charges apply.

name: Cudmore Grove Country Park Play Areas
text: Nautical-themed play areas in Essex County Council's Cudmore Grove Country Park on Mersea Island, including a pirate ship and a sandpit. Car park charges apply.

name: Belhus Woods Country Park Play Area
text: A music-themed play area with outdoor musical instruments and a rope ladder in Essex County Council's Belhus Woods Country Park, which has a café. Car park charges apply.

name: Weald Country Park Play Areas
text: Two small play areas in Essex County Council's Weald Country Park, one for younger children and one with slides and monkey bars, on the Stick Man sculpture trail. Car park charges apply.

name: Hadleigh Country Park Play Area
text: A children's play area in Essex County Council's Hadleigh Country Park, resurfaced in 2026; the park also has pump tracks. Car park charges apply.
